scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.build: node server/check-react-styles.js && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.check: npm run lint --prefix client && node --check server/server.js && node --check server/database.js && npm run check:mocks && npm run build --prefix client
